scenario: champion_baselines (pair snapshot, no fight behind it)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <fresh scratch dir>
evidence_tree.scope_respected: only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read; src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, and git history were not consulted

independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_slot: data/champions.json has exactly one wiki ability entry per Syndra slot (P/Q/W/E/R); there is no separate 'Q2' wiki ability. The only Q-adjacent second-cast mechanic in the cached wiki text is Dark Sphere's stocked charge: Q effect 2 reads 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' The cached audit corpus independently confirms this is what the synthetic slot denotes: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json records Syndra module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] with note 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)', and data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json records '40+ Q charges via Q2 slot'. So Q2 is a second cast of Dark Sphere, not a distinct ability.
independent_computation.step_2_resource_of_that_cast: Dark Sphere's cached wiki record carries resource = "MANA" and cost = {values: [40, 45, 50, 55, 60]} (one cost entry covering every cast of the ability), plus rechargeRate = [7, 7, 7, 7, 7] for the charge stock. The wiki gives no second, cheaper, or free cost entry for the stocked cast, and no note anywhere in Syndra's record says a charged cast is free or costs anything other than mana. Therefore a Q2 cast consumes the same resource as a Q cast: mana.
independent_computation.step_3_rule_out_CHARGE: The cached data model does distinguish charge-costed abilities: across all champions the ability-level 'resource' field takes values {MANA: 549, null: 329, ENERGY: 21, OTHER: 16, CURRENT_HEALTH: 9, CHARGE: 4, MANA_PER_SECOND: 3, HEALTH: 3, GRIT: 1, FURY: 1, MAXIMUM_HEALTH: 1}. Gangplank E (Powder Keg) is one of the CHARGE cases: resource = "CHARGE", cost = 1, rechargeRate = [17,16,15,14,13] — an ability whose cast is paid for with a keg charge and no mana. Syndra's Dark Sphere is deliberately not modelled that way: it has rechargeRate (charges) AND resource = "MANA" with a mana cost, i.e. the charge is an extra cast opportunity, not the currency. Ahri R (Spirit Rush), also described as a stocked-cast ability in data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json, likewise carries resource = "MANA", cost 100. So "CHARGE" is not the right value for Q2; "MANA" is.
independent_computation.step_4_rule_out_absent: Absent would assert the Q2 cast consumes no resource. That contradicts the cached wiki: every Dark Sphere cast is priced by the single Q cost block (40/45/50/55/60 mana), and the passive Transcendent even funds it — 'Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores 20 : 255 (based on level) mana' — which only makes sense if the extra charged casts are still mana-paid. A synthetic slot mirroring Dark Sphere inherits Dark Sphere's resource.
independent_computation.step_5_level_11_check: The leaf sits under abilities_level_11. resource_type is rank- and level-independent for this ability: the wiki resource field is a single scalar "MANA" (unlike cost, whose per-rank values are 40/45/50/55/60). At champion level 11 Dark Sphere is at rank 5 (cost 60 mana), but the resource type is "MANA" at every rank, so level 11 changes nothing about the expected value.
independent_computation.conclusion: Expected /champion_baselines/Syndra/abilities_level_11/Q2/resource_type = "MANA". The new value matches; the old (absent) value under-reported the synthetic second-charge slot's resource.

no formula or convention governing ability resource_type appears in this document (searched 'resource', 'Syndra', 'splinter', 'charge'); the ruling therefore rests entirely on the cached wiki text under data/.
